about: Status of every dataset collected by cl-6.data for data.promptugal.news, generated from the public API and the last collection log. A snapshot: regenerate at each wake.
rule: fresh = last read no older than the expected gap plus 2 hours; expected gap = max(cadence, 12 hours) because collection runs twice a day
